newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline steady in moribund market.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline steady in moribund market.

text.p: NWE gasoline was steady on Wednesday in an extremely quiet market, traders said.
"This is the quietest day for ages. It's quieter than Monday when half of Europe was closed." said one trader.
Eurograde barges were talked around $206/$208 a tonne fob ARA for prompt delivery and $208/$209 for June delivery -- unchanged from Tuesday's levels.
The last deal heard last night was at $207.75 fob Rotterdam for delivery up to June 5.
Swaps, meanwhile, were assessed a little easier at $207.50/$209 for June and $201/$203.00 for July.
Traders said American Petroleum Institute (API) U.S. oil stock data released on Tuesday had minimal impact on the market.
The data showed a 837,000 barrel build in U.S. gasoline stocks and a 1.4 million barrel drop in reformulated gasoline stocks.
NWE Cargo stocks remained on the tight side resulting in fairly steep prices. Premium unleaded was assessed at around $214/$218 on a cif NWE basis.
Traders estimate some 150-200,000 tonnes of European gasoline will arrive in the United States between May 15 and June 5.
